observations: Three retail boxes for HP printers are stacked on a concrete floor.
The boxes are clearly labeled 'HP OfficeJet Pro 9720 Wide Format'.
The HP logo and product illustrations are visible on the packaging.
A watermark for 'CAPITAL MULTIBIZ ENTERPRISE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the center.
The actual printers are not visible, only the closed boxes.

risks.risk: The boxes may be empty or contain a different item than labeled.
risks.proof: A photo of the printer outside of the box showing the model name on the chassis.

risks.risk: The printer may have internal damage or be non-functional despite the new-looking packaging.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a test page.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual printer outside of the box.
Video of the printer powered on and performing a print test.
Photo of the serial number and model sticker on the back or underside of the printer.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the retail packaging in the photo, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case functional condition (not working).
